description: Load one public page in headless Chrome through a residential IP in the chosen country, so JavaScript runs: single-page apps, prices and content filled in by scripts. Returns markdown (or text/html), title, final URL, the extracted product price, and optionally a JPEG screenshot as an image. $0.020 per page, +$0.020 with a screenshot (x402, USDC on Base), charged only if the page loads. Use fetch_page_from_country first for ordinary pages: it's cheaper. Public pages only; robots.txt respected; no CAPTCHA solving.

city.description: Optional city for the exit IP, needs country. +$0.005.

country.description: Country of the residential exit IP, e.g. de, jp, br (default: any)

format.description: markdown (default, best for reading), text, or raw html

wait_for.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for (up to 10 s), e.g. .price

wait_ms.description: Optional extra wait after the page settles, in ms

name: render_page_from_country
title: Load a JavaScript page in a real browser from a country (optional screenshot)
